title: Silas and the Witness
author: Elodie Ashgrove
blurb: Rosalind Nakamura, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
